semantic_findings.title: Unsafe SQL Construction in pgvector Filter
semantic_findings.description: The pgvector template interpolates filter metadata keys into a SQL condition while only parameterizing values. If callers pass untrusted keys, copied applications could allow SQL injection.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code directly inserts the metadata key into the SQL string. Values are parameterized, but identifier-like input is not validated or safely quoted.

content.value_statement: Teams need fast retrieval that balances relevance, latency, and scale. This skill provides vector database patterns for semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, and production tuning.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use similarity search for semantic search, RAG retrieval, recommendations, and latency optimization.
Compares cosine, Euclidean, dot product, and Manhattan distance metrics for embedding search.
Describes flat, HNSW, and IVF plus PQ index choices for different scale and recall goals.
Provides implementation patterns for Pinecone, Qdrant, pgvector, and Weaviate.
Covers hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, reranking, batching, and operational tuning.
limitations: Does not generate embeddings or choose the best embedding model for every domain.
Requires users to adapt examples to their database, schema, and security requirements.
Examples are guidance, not tested production packages.
Does not benchmark performance against a live workload by itself.

use_cases.title: Design a RAG Retriever
use_cases.description: Plan a vector retrieval layer with filters, top-k settings, reranking, and hybrid search options.

use_cases.title: Choose a Vector Store
use_cases.description: Compare Pinecone, Qdrant, pgvector, and Weaviate patterns against scale, hosting, and latency needs.

use_cases.title: Improve Search Quality
use_cases.description: Review distance metrics, index settings, recall tradeoffs, and reranking strategies for an existing search system.

prompt_templates.title: Select a Search Pattern
prompt_templates.prompt: I need semantic search for my application. Ask for the minimum requirements, then recommend a similarity search pattern and vector database option.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning a new retrieval feature.

prompt_templates.title: Design a RAG Index
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a RAG retrieval index for my documents. Include metadata filtering, chunk strategy, distance metric, and reranking guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Latency and Recall
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my similarity search design for latency and recall. Recommend index settings, batching, hybrid search, and evaluation metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Production Architectures
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Pinecone, Qdrant, pgvector, and Weaviate for my workload. Include scaling limits, operational effort, cost drivers, and migration risks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced architecture review before platform selection.

output_examples.input: A product team needs search across 100,000 help articles with PostgreSQL already in use.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend pgvector as a simple starting point, cosine distance for normalized embeddings, and hybrid text search for exact terms.

output_examples.input: A RAG application returns related documents but misses exact product names.
output_examples.output: The skill would suggest hybrid retrieval, metadata filters, over-fetching candidates, and reranking the top results before answer generation.

output_examples.input: A search service is slow after growing to millions of vectors.
output_examples.output: The skill would compare HNSW and quantized index options, then tune recall, memory, and latency with measured benchmarks.

best_practices: Start with clear recall, latency, and cost targets before choosing an index.
Use hybrid search when exact terms and semantic meaning both matter.
Measure retrieval quality before changing index parameters or adding reranking.
anti_patterns: Do not choose a vector database before defining workload size and filtering needs.
Do not rely only on semantic scores when exact identifiers must match.
Do not copy database templates without adding validation and access controls.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps design and implement similarity search systems with vector databases and hybrid retrieval patterns.

faq.question: Which vector databases are covered?
faq.answer: The playbook covers Pinecone, Qdrant, pgvector, and Weaviate implementation patterns.

faq.question: Can it help with RAG applications?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes retrieval patterns, metadata filters, reranking guidance, and hybrid search advice for RAG systems.

faq.question: Does it create embeddings?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on storing, querying, filtering, and ranking embeddings after they are created.

faq.question: Can I use it for large vector collections?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains index choices, scaling tradeoffs, batching, and latency considerations for larger collections.

faq.question: Is the example code production ready?
faq.answer: No. Treat the examples as patterns and add validation, testing, monitoring, and security controls before production use.
